zoe: Heads-up: new Private egress & SIEM integration policy is live for GA customers. This specifies allowed egress endpoints, signed-delivery proofs for exported logs, and a new per-customer whitelist for SIEM targets. Docs: https://internal.redwood.io/docs/private/egress-siem-policy
ops-bot: Policy doc uploaded: private-egress-siem-policy v1.0 by zoe — 1782701111
marcel: Important Q: does whitelist mean we block all outbound except explicit targets?
zoe: Yes 1 default-deny outbound. Customers must register approved endpoints (S3, HTTPS, syslog) during enablement. We provide an intake API and a signed manifest for each endpoint.
fiona: Security ask: what about delivering to customer-managed SIEMs that are behind NAT/peered VPCs? Any special flow?
zoe: We documented three delivery modes: 1) direct HTTPS with mTLS, 2) S3 push with cross-account role + SSE-KMS, 3) relay agent for isolated networks (customer-run). Relay mode signs bundles locally and forwards when allowed.
darius: Compliance note: we added cryptographic proof-of-delivery. Each export has a manifest: ledger_hash, delivery_target, ts, and a signature from our signing key. Example manifest snippet in docs.
compliance-bot: New policy flag: SIEM_EGRESS_MODE = enforced 1 enforcement scheduled 2026-05-01
marcel: For pilots, can we allow a temporary permissive mode? some customers need a short testing window.
zoe: Pilots can opt into a 48-hour test window via the onboarding UI; must be approved by Security and marked in the runbook. We'll require post-test verification.
fiona: Ops ask: do we have a verification script for sales/field engs to validate deliveries?
zoe: Yes 1 added a verify script: `./verify_delivery --archive delivered.tar.gz --manifest manifest.json --pubkey redwood-signer.pem`. Docs include a small Python verifier.
sales-bot: Sales request: customers want a short blurb for compliance teams explaining non-repudiation guarantees. Can we surface a 2-line summary?
zoe: I'll post a 2-line customer-facing blurb and a one-pager for sales by EOD. It will mention: cryptographic proof-of-delivery, configurable retention, and explicit endpoint whitelist.
marcel: Action items: 1) Security to review relay signing details (fiona), 2) Ops to add egress preflight to installer (darius), 3) Sales to prep one-pager (sales-bot). I'll follow up in the doc thread. :lock::rocket:
